column1: # parallel-coverage.tsv -- coordination metadata, NOT a source of solutions.
# WHAT THIS IS.  A second, independent Golden Sun decompilation exists at
# This file records, per function, whether that project has covered it.  It exists
# so neither project wastes effort duplicating the other, and so we can offer them
# WHY IT IS ONLY POINTERS.  Every repository in this chain is UNLICENSED -- gsret/
# goldensun (our upstream), this fork, and alchemy.  With no licence the default is
# all rights reserved, so no code may be copied in either direction, and attribution
# does not change that.  A reference to where something lives is a fact, not a
# reproduction, so this file is safe where copied code would not be.
# DO NOT USE THIS TO WRITE OUR C.  Reading their implementation of a function and
# then writing ours makes ours DERIVED from theirs even if no byte is copied, which
# destroys the one thing `make compare` is evidence of: that our C is independent
# work from our own disassembly.  This file deliberately carries NO pointers to
# their sources for that reason.  Use it to decide WHAT to work on, never HOW.
# HOW IT WAS DERIVED.  Their not-yet-C set is exactly recoverable: recon/tbs/raw/
# holds one file per function named by hex address, and recon/tbs/unidentified.s
# carries `.incbin` spans for bytes they have not identified.  Joined against our
# KNOWN LIMITS, all of which understate what we have and they lack:
#   - MAIN ROM ONLY.  Our overlay functions live at RAM addresses and cannot be
#     joined by ROM offset, so no OvlFunc_* appears here at all.
#   - 163 of their 462 not-done addresses matched no symbol of ours, most likely
#     because the two projects drew function boundaries differently.  Worth
#     resolving before trading work: a function we bounded wrongly would fail
#   - Only their raw/ set was joined; functions of ours sitting inside their
#   they_lack   we have elevated it, they have not -- offerable
#   frontier    neither project has elevated it -- where to work
# note: `clean` = no fakematch row, so asm-free and acceptable to their rules,
# which forbid inline asm; `fakematch` = carries pins and would need de-pinning
# first; `parked`/`available` = our own state for frontier rows.
